cards.name: Amass the Components
cards.oracleText: Draw three cards, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library.

cards.name: A-Masked Bandits
cards.oracleText:
Vigilance
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
{1}, Exile Masked Bandits from your hand: Target land gains "{T}: Add {B}, {R}, or {G}" until Masked Bandits is cast from exile. You may cast Masked Bandits for as long as it remains exiled.

cards.name: A-Master of Winds
cards.oracleText:
Flying
When Master of Winds enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may have Master of Winds's base power and toughness become 5/1 or 1/5 until end of turn.
